A unique engineering achievement: The Falkirk Wheel in Scotland is the world’s first and only rotating boat lift.
一项独特的工程成就。: 苏格兰的福尔柯克轮是世界上第一座、也是唯一一座旋转式升船机。
unique|adj. 独特的: world’s first and only|世界首创且唯一的

A unique engineering achievement: Opened in 2002, it is central to the ambitious £84.5m Millennium Link project to restore navigability across Scotland by reconnecting the historic waterways of the Forth & Clyde and Union Canals.
一项独特的工程成就。: 这座升船机于2002年启用，是耗资8450万英镑的宏伟“千禧连接”项目的核心。项目旨在把历史悠久的福斯-克莱德运河与联合运河重新连通，恢复穿越苏格兰的通航能力。

A unique engineering achievement: The major challenge of the project lay in the fact that the Forth & Clyde Canal is situated 35 metres below the level of the Union Canal.
一项独特的工程成就。: 该项目的主要难题，是福斯-克莱德运河的水面比联合运河低35米。
column6: below the level of|低于……的水位

A unique engineering achievement: Historically, the two canals had been joined near the town of Falkirk by a sequence of 11 locks - enclosed sections of canal in which the water level could be raised or lowered - that stepped down across a distance of 1.5 km.
一项独特的工程成就。: 过去，两条运河在福尔柯克镇附近通过一连串共11座船闸相接。船闸是水位可升可降的封闭河段；这些船闸在1.5公里内逐级下降。
unique|adj. 独特的: near the town of|在……镇附近
column6: enclosed sections of canal|封闭的运河河段
column9: across a distance of|在长达……的距离内

A unique engineering achievement: This had been dismantled in 1933, thereby breaking the link.
一项独特的工程成就。: 1933年，这一系列船闸被拆除，两条运河的连接也就中断了。

A unique engineering achievement: When the project was launched in 1994, the British Waterways authority were keen to create a dramatic twenty-first-century landmark which would not only be a fitting commemoration of the Millennium, but also a lasting symbol of the economic regeneration of the region.
一项独特的工程成就。: 项目于1994年启动时，英国水道管理局很想建造一座引人注目的21世纪地标。它既要足以纪念新千年的到来，也要成为当地经济复兴的长久象征。

A unique engineering achievement: Numerous ideas were submitted for the project, including concepts ranging from rolling eggs to tilting tanks, from giant see-saws to overhead monorails.
一项独特的工程成就。: 项目收到了众多设计构想，从滚动的蛋形装置到倾斜的水槽，从巨型跷跷板到架空单轨车，五花八门。

A unique engineering achievement: The eventual winner was a plan for the huge rotating steel boat lift which was to become The Falkirk Wheel.
一项独特的工程成就。: 最后胜出的是一座巨型钢制旋转升船机的方案，这座升船机就是后来的福尔柯克轮。

A unique engineering achievement: The unique shape of the structure is claimed to have been inspired by various sources, both manmade and natural, most notably a Celtic double-headed axe, but also the vast turning propeller of a ship, the ribcage of a whale or the spine of a fish.
一项独特的工程成就。: 据说，这一结构独特的造型受到多种人造物和自然形态的启发，其中最突出的是凯尔特双头斧，还有船只巨大的旋转螺旋桨、鲸的胸廓和鱼的脊骨。

A unique engineering achievement: The various parts of The Falkirk Wheel were all constructed and assembled, like one giant toy building set, at Butterley Engineering’s Steelworks in Derbyshire, some 400 km from Falkirk.
一项独特的工程成就。: 福尔柯克轮的各部件起初都在德比郡的巴特利工程公司钢铁厂制造并组装，就像拼装一套巨型组合玩具。钢厂距福尔柯克约400公里。

A unique engineering achievement: A team there carefully assembled the 1,200 tonnes of steel, painstakingly fitting the pieces together to an accuracy of just 10 mm to ensure a perfect final fit.
一项独特的工程成就。: 那里的团队精心组装了1200吨钢构件，费尽心思地逐件拼合，把精度控制在10毫米以内，以确保最终完全契合。
column6: fitting the pieces together|拼合各个部件

A unique engineering achievement: In the summer of 2001, the structure was then dismantled and transported on 35 lorries to Falkirk, before all being bolted back together again on the ground, and finally lifted into position in five large sections by crane.
一项独特的工程成就。: 2001年夏天，整个结构又被拆开，由35辆卡车运到福尔柯克，然后在地面用螺栓重新组装，最后由起重机分五大段吊装就位。
column6: bolted back together|用螺栓重新连接

A unique engineering achievement: The Wheel would need to withstand immense and constantly changing stresses as it rotated, so to make the structure more robust, the steel sections were bolted rather than welded together.
一项独特的工程成就。: 升船机旋转时要承受巨大且不断变化的应力。因此，为了让结构更加坚固，钢段之间采用螺栓连接，没有采用焊接。

A unique engineering achievement: Over 45,000 bolt holes were matched with their bolts, and each bolt was hand-tightened.
一项独特的工程成就。: 超过45000个螺栓孔都与相应的螺栓一一匹配，每一颗螺栓都由人工拧紧。

A unique engineering achievement: The Wheel consists of two sets of opposing axe-shaped arms, attached about 25 metres apart to a fixed central spine.
一项独特的工程成就。: 升船机有两组彼此相对的斧形臂架，两组相隔约25米，安装在一个固定的中央支架上。
column6: about 25 metres apart|相距约二十五米
column7: fixed central spine|固定的中央支架

A unique engineering achievement: Two diametrically opposed water-filled ‘gondolas’, each with a capacity of 360,000 litres, are fitted between the ends of the arms.
一项独特的工程成就。: 臂架的端部之间装着两个位置正好相对、充满水的“承船水槽”，每个容量均为36万升。
unique|adj. 独特的: diametrically opposed|在直径两端正相对的

A unique engineering achievement: These gondolas always weigh the same, whether or not they are carrying boats.
一项独特的工程成就。: 无论是否载有船只，这两个水槽的重量始终相同。

A unique engineering achievement: This is because, according to Archimedes’ principle of displacement, floating objects displace their own weight in water.
一项独特的工程成就。: 原因在于，按照阿基米德排水原理，漂浮物排开的水与它本身的重量相等。
unique|adj. 独特的: Archimedes’ principle of displacement|阿基米德排水原理

A unique engineering achievement: So when a boat enters a gondola, the amount of water leaving the gondola weighs exactly the same as the boat.
一项独特的工程成就。: 所以，一艘船驶入水槽时，排出水槽的水与这艘船的重量完全相同。
column6: weighs exactly the same as|与……重量完全相同

A unique engineering achievement: This keeps the Wheel balanced and so, despite its enormous mass, it rotates through 180° in five and a half minutes while using very little power.
一项独特的工程成就。: 这样一来，升船机便能保持平衡，所以尽管自身质量巨大，仍能在五分半钟内转过180度，而且耗能极少。
column7: five and a half minutes|五分半钟

A unique engineering achievement: It takes just 1.5 kilowatt-hours (5.4 MJ) of energy to rotate the Wheel — roughly the same as boiling eight small domestic kettles of water.
一项独特的工程成就。: 让福尔柯克轮这样转动只需1.5千瓦时（5.4兆焦）的能量，大约相当于用小号家用水壶烧开八壶水。
column6: roughly the same as|大致相当于

A unique engineering achievement: Boats needing to be lifted up enter the canal basin at the level of the Forth & Clyde Canal and then enter the lower gondola of the Wheel.
一项独特的工程成就。: 需要提升的船只先进入与福斯-克莱德运河水位相同的船池，再驶入升船机下方的承船水槽。
column5: at the level of|与……同一水位

A unique engineering achievement: Two hydraulic steel gates are raised, so as to seal the gondola off from the water in the canal basin.
一项独特的工程成就。: 两道液压钢闸门升起，把水槽与船池里的水隔开。
column5: seal the gondola off|将承船水槽封闭隔离

A unique engineering achievement: The water between the gates is then pumped out.
一项独特的工程成就。: 随后，两道闸门之间的水被抽走。

A unique engineering achievement: A hydraulic clamp, which prevents the arms of the Wheel moving while the gondola is docked, is removed, allowing the Wheel to turn.
一项独特的工程成就。: 水槽停靠时，有一个液压夹将升船机的臂架固定不动。现在把夹具移开，升船机便可以旋转了。

A unique engineering achievement: In the central machine room an array of ten hydraulic motors then begins to rotate the central axle.
一项独特的工程成就。: 接着，中央机房里的一组共十台液压马达开始带动中心轴旋转。

A unique engineering achievement: The axle connects to the outer arms of the Wheel, which begin to rotate at a speed of 1/8 of a revolution per minute.
一项独特的工程成就。: 中心轴与升船机的外臂相连，外臂开始以每分钟八分之一圈的速度旋转。
column5: at a speed of|以……的速度
column6: 1/8 of a revolution per minute|每分钟八分之一圈

A unique engineering achievement: As the wheel rotates, the gondolas are kept in the upright position by a simple gearing system.
一项独特的工程成就。: 升船机转动时，一个简单的齿轮系统使承船水槽始终保持正立。

A unique engineering achievement: Two eight-metre-wide cogs orbit a fixed inner cog of the same width, connected by two smaller cogs travelling in the opposite direction to the outer cogs - so ensuring that the gondolas always remain level.
一项独特的工程成就。: 两个宽八米的齿轮绕着一个同宽的固定内齿轮转动，它们之间由两个较小的齿轮相连；小齿轮的转动方向与外齿轮相反，从而确保承船水槽始终保持水平。
column5: fixed inner cog|固定的内齿轮

A unique engineering achievement: When the gondola reaches the top, the boat passes straight onto the aqueduct situated 24 metres above the canal basin.
一项独特的工程成就。: 当水槽到达顶部，船就直接驶入位于船池上方24米的渡槽。

A unique engineering achievement: The remaining 11 metres of lift needed to reach the Union Canal is achieved by means of a pair of locks.
一项独特的工程成就。: 要到达联合运河还需要再升高11米，这段高差借助两座船闸完成。
column6: a pair of locks|两座船闸

A unique engineering achievement: The Wheel could not be constructed to elevate boats over the full 35-metre difference between the two canals, owing to the presence of the historically important Antonine Wall, which was built by the Romans in the second century AD.
一项独特的工程成就。: 升船机无法设计成一次完成两条运河间全部35米的提升，因为这里有历史价值很高的安东尼长城，它是罗马人在公元2世纪修建的。
engineering achievement|工程成就: full 35-metre difference|全部三十五米高差
column6: historically important|具有重要历史价值的

A unique engineering achievement: Boats travel under this wall via a tunnel, then through the locks, and finally on to the Union Canal.
一项独特的工程成就。: 船只经隧道从长城下方穿过，再通过船闸，最后抵达联合运河。
